label: null_handling
explanation: The product has a flat late fee but no percentage fee and no cap. Legacy charges the flat fee; the new code charges zero, which suggests the missing percentage is treated as zero in a comparison that should ignore it.
evidence: legacy LATE_FEE 250.00 versus new 0.00 on the same date
product has a flat fee and no percentage fee in the reference data
suggested_fix: When one of the fee components is missing, use the other instead of treating the missing one as zero.
